note: North Cascades, Sahale Arm. Down the heather crest of the arm, the way the trail goes, with late snow lying beside the fairway; then off the end of it to a green on a shelf above Doubtful Lake: 160 yards over the drop to the lower fairway, or 240 straight at the flag. The crest is taken as level under the line ("level") and the hole is played as level ground ("heights": false); the shelf is made.
